signature_scheme: WebCrypto ECDSA SHA-256 P-256 IEEE P1363 64-byte raw signature
canonical_contract: JSON.stringify over fixed ordered transferFields and receiptFields
requirements: distinct sender and receiver key IDs and declared custodians
receipt binds transfer SHA-256 and capture SHA-256
challenge, sequence, time ordering and non-replayed identity
